- Remit instructions: ACH preferred to the account on the attached bank letter
- Preferred PO contact: Sasha Nguyen (sasha.nguyen@ledgerworks.com)

Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — LedgerWorks (legal entity / remit)

Thanks Sasha — this is great and very thorough. Looping in Kimberly from Finance and Monica from Vendor Ops so we can get LedgerWorks into our vendor master. 

Kimberly / Monica — Sasha sent the W-9 and bank letter. A few items we need to confirm for our ERP and PO flow: 

1) Legal name confirmation (LedgerWorks, Inc.) and whether you want the DBA field populated as a separate line.
2) Invoice remit email and whether LedgerWorks prefers invoices to go to accounts@ledgerworks.com or to an AP portal (if yes, please share portal URL and a sample invoice).
3) Confirm ACH account instructions are OK to store in vendor record (we keep bank info encrypted and only Finance has access).
4) Primary PO contact (name, title, direct phone) — Sasha listed herself, but confirm if there is a secondary contact for ticketing.
5) Are there any special tax forms for your state (CA) we should capture beyond the W-9?
6) Desired payment terms (Net30/Net45/etc.) and any early-pay discount programs.

Sasha — once Kimberly confirms, Monica will create a draft vendor record and send a short test PO to the provided PO contact. If you require a signed vendor agreement before POs are accepted, please resend the link to the DocuSign or upload it to the portal in the related_links above.

Irene

Irene Choi
Vendor Onboarding Manager
Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com

From: Sasha Nguyen <sasha.nguyen@ledgerworks.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-11T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — LedgerWorks (legal entity / remit)

Hi Irene / Kimberly / Monica — thanks for the fast follow-up. Answers below inline: 

> 1) Legal name confirmation (LedgerWorks, Inc.) and DBA?
We confirm legal name is LedgerWorks, Inc. Please add DBA as LedgerWorks Analytics in the "doing business as" field.

> 2) Invoice remit email or portal?
We prefer invoices via email to accounts@ledgerworks.com. We do have an AP portal (https://ap.ledgerworks.com/login) but it is used for invoice status only — submissions are typically emailed. Sample invoice attached (PDF).

> 3) Store ACH in vendor record?
Yes, that is fine. We provide an ACH verification letter rather than a voided check; that's attached.

> 4) Primary PO contact
Sasha Nguyen — Head of Revenue Operations — +1 (619) 555-0143. Secondary: Miguel Torres <miguel.torres@ledgerworks.com>, Procurement Specialist, +1 (619) 555-0167.

> 5) State tax forms?
No additional CA forms required beyond the W-9 for our entity.

> 6) Payment terms
Standard Net30. We don't have early-pay discounts at this time.

We have also attached a PDF sample invoice: Invoice_4521_LedgerWorks.pdf (not included in thread attachments list because it was forwarded to AP separately).

If you want a signed master services agreement before accepting POs, I can route DocuSign today — otherwise, we are good to accept a test/one-off PO to validate routing and payment.

Regards,
Sasha

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.com, Sasha Nguyen <sasha.nguyen@ledgerworks.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-12T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — LedgerWorks (legal entity / remit)

Hi Sasha / Irene — appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. Kimberly here from Finance — copying Karthik to note any procurement-specific routing for POs. 

We will proceed with the following: 
- Monica will create the vendor master record with legal name = "LedgerWorks, Inc.", DBA = "LedgerWorks Analytics", remit email = accounts@ledgerworks.com, and store the encrypted ACH details per our policy.
- Default payment terms set to Net30 unless you submit a signed amendment.
- We'll issue a test PO (PO-RED-20261112-001) to Sasha and Miguel to validate acceptance and invoicing. Please confirm acceptance of that PO when you receive it.

Sasha — re: signed agreement: we can accept the test PO before the master service agreement is fully executed (we tag the vendor record as "onboarding - agreement pending"). If you can route the DocuSign via the link in related_links that would be ideal; otherwise we will process the PO and hold payment until agreement is returned per the flagged status.

Next steps for Monica: create record, send test PO later today. Estimated time to payment after invoice submission (and assuming Net30) is 30 calendar days.

Thanks — Kimberly
